title: Agis king of Sparta
summary: Raleigh names Agis king of Sparta in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Agis, one of the Kings of Sparta in the Peloponnesian Warre, whose wife called her yong child by Alcibiades his name, and who with Pausanias summoned Athens after Aegos-Potamos. He is not Agis, the second of the Heraclidae. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
